cases.prompt: Conduct an Apple-grade audit on this repository's verification level and code craft. Discard any conversational complacency or prior AI praise and look for subtle invariant defects and failure modes. Answer in chat only; do not modify or create files.
criteria: Adopts an uncompromising, adversarial auditor posture without conversational flattery
Checks verification depth and distinguishes between vanity tests and proof of invariants
Audits error handling, failure paths, rollback integrity, and edge case resilience
Checks type craft, single responsibility, and elimination of dead or misleading code
Provides evidence-backed findings and prioritized remediation without inventing a numerical quality score
Identifies expect(res).toBeDefined() as a low-signal vanity assertion
Flags missing verification of invariant outcomes (balance reduction, idempotency, receipt creation)
Highlights absence of failure case testing (network timeout, insufficient funds, duplicate submissions)
Recommends concrete adversarial assertions that prove correctness
Identifies loose any[] typing and lack of domain validation
Identifies sequential per-item database work as a potential throughput bottleneck and considers safe batching or bounded concurrency without asserting measured impact
Points out that a failure halfway through leaves partial, uncommitted state without transactional rollback
Explains that success is returned only if all saves resolve; identifies possible partial persisted state on rejection without falsely claiming promises are unhandled
Does not claim forward slashes alone break Windows; focuses on untrusted path containment and normalization
Recommends using path.join or path.resolve
Warns about missing directory existence verification or path traversal risks if sub contains relative segments
Suggests robust error and boundary handling

cases.prompt: List the edge cases I should test for this endpoint that transfers credits between users: POST /transfer {from, to, amount}. Answer in chat only; do not modify or create files.
criteria: Includes negative, zero or huge amounts / malformed input
Includes double submission or retries (idempotency)
Includes concurrent transfers / race conditions
Includes transfer to self or to a nonexistent user
Includes partial failure between debit and credit (atomicity / rollback)
